contract.input: finite BF16; subnormals flushed to signed zero
contract.amax: A=max(2^-112,max(abs(x))) over the complete independent row
contract.not_equivalent_to: old rounded DivF amax/7 contract or old power2 quantizer

implementation.amax: Copy the established whole-H finite-BF16 amax reduction and floor; no new Add reduction
implementation.core_slices: [B16%8,H3840/960,Threshold8], two B/8 clusters; all256 slices percluster
implementation.comparison: ((odd*(Ma<<delta)-(14*Mx+1)) arithmetic_shift_right31) is -1 exactly when threshold passes
implementation.reduce: exact signed-I32 inter-slice Add over eight threshold slices; restore sign in a separate pass
includes: canonical I32 code and F32 scale stores

resource_screen.failure_action: HOLD before device ELF build; preserve failures and report the concrete bound; no blind shape sweep

probe_plan.oracle: independent integer-rational BF16 decoder and quotient/remainder ties-away rounding; does not count the seven candidate thresholds
coverage: all normalized mantissa pairs for delta0..4
positive/negative mathematical ties and nearest BF16 neighbors
probe_plan.scale_oracle: f32 multiply by the exact RN32(1/7) bit pattern, compare bits
probe_plan.limits: Exact code foundation only. Model approximation quality, packing-inclusive cost and complete FFN remain unproved. No 2x throughput claim.

authorization: source/type check and exact resource compilation only; no Arena, production edits or model activation
